headline: В Ашхабаде ОАО «НЭСК» и корпорация «Туркменэнерго» подписали соглашение
summary: NESK and Turkmenenergo signed an agreement in Ashgabat during the seventh meeting of the Kyrgyz-Turkmen intergovernmental commission on trade, economic, scientific and humanitarian cooperation.
why: Cross-border electricity arrangements between Central Asian states shape regional power trade and energy security. Intergovernmental commissions set the framework for such commercial deals.
